scope: CI-only change: root package.json/yarn.lock as single dependency source, Codemagic frozen-lockfile scripts, Capacitor paths/bundle id, no app regression

checks.criterion: The actual repository structure is used for iOS CI
checks.name: repo-structure-single-dependency-source
checks.evidence: bash: /app/package.json has 60 deps, packageManager yarn@1.22.22, workspaces=None; /app/yarn.lock present; /app/frontend/package.json has no dependencies field (only dev/build/start scripts delegating to root); /app/frontend/yarn.lock absent (ls: cannot access 'frontend/yarn.lock': No such file or directory).

checks.criterion: Yarn lockfile matches the root package.json
checks.name: yarn-lockfile-frozen-install
checks.evidence: cd /app && yarn install --non-interactive --ignore-engines -> 'success Already up-to-date.' Done in 0.16s; yarn install --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive --ignore-engines -> 'success Already up-to-date.' Done in 0.16s, exit 0. Yarn version confirmed 1.22.22.

checks.criterion: Codemagic stays frozen and uses the root
checks.name: codemagic-scripts-root-resolution
checks.evidence: Read /app/codemagic.yaml: both 'Abhängigkeiten installieren' scripts (ios-testflight and ios-build-check workflows) contain REPO_ROOT="${CM_BUILD_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}"; cd "$REPO_ROOT"; test -f package.json; test -f yarn.lock; test -f capacitor.config.ts; test -d ios/App/App.xcodeproj; followed by corepack prepare yarn@1.22.22 --activate and yarn install --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive --ignore-engines.

checks.name: capacitor-paths-and-bundle-id
checks.evidence: find confirms /app/capacitor.config.ts and /app/ios/App/App.xcodeproj exist at repo root. grep: capacitor.config.ts line 8 appId: "de.leonida.explorer"; project.pbxproj lines 313/335 PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = de.leonida.explorer;

checks.criterion: No app regression from the CI-only change
checks.name: app-loads-no-errors
checks.evidence: cd /app && yarn build completed successfully ('✓ built in 641ms', nitro output generated, 'Done in 4.15s', exit 0). Browser check against public preview URL https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com loaded the app, body visible, no thrown errors. Screenshot: app-loads-no-errors-home.png. Additionally existing backend pytest suite (24 tests, unrelated app features) still passes: '24 passed, 1 warning in 3.78s', confirming no collateral backend regression.

action_items: GitHub is not connected in this job (per briefing), so the updated yarn.lock and codemagic.yaml exist only in the local workspace; user must save them to Branch Emergent to persist the fix.

The remote Codemagic macOS job itself could not be executed (Linux workspace); verification was done by replicating the exact root-resolution and frozen-install commands locally, which is the best available proxy.
notes: This briefing is a CI/build-tooling change with no new application UI or API surface, so all 5 acceptance-matrix items were verified via direct file/structure inspection and command execution (yarn install --frozen-lockfile, build) rather than new backend HTTP tests or UI flows (none apply). One browser check was run against the public preview URL to confirm no app regression. Pre-existing backend pytest suite (payments, health, chat migration - unrelated to this CI change) was also re-run and remains green. git diff shows yarn.lock has pending uncommitted changes relative to last commit, consistent with seed_facts describing the lockfile as freshly synchronized but not yet pushed.
